plans.text: Try a hybrid approach by posting manuscript snippets as new sections are completed, maintaining a consistent posting frequency, and asking followers about their content preferences.

Post a poll on an Instagram Story with three options—"More writing tips and advice," "More behind-the-scenes content," and "More sneak peeks of my manuscript"—and ask followers to share their thoughts and opinions in the comments.

Create a follow-up story featuring a graphic or screenshot of the poll results, context or insights about what was learned, thanks to followers for participating and providing feedback, and a highlight of the winning option.
Try using the "Question Sticker" feature in Instagram Stories first for the Q&A session.
Promote the Q&A session by announcing it in advance, creating a branded hashtag, and specifying the topic or theme as writing process and experiences as a freelancer.
Answer a selection of questions, address common themes, provide additional resources for questions that cannot be answered, and communicate expectations to followers.

Post a quick Instagram Story update to remind followers about the Q&A session tomorrow, invite questions about the writing process, freelancing, or anything else using the "Question Sticker," and use #QandAwith[YourName], #WritingCommunity, and #FreelanceLife.

superseded_plans.text: Start sharing snippets of the manuscript on Instagram Stories.
Try out a Q&A session idea.

preferences.text: Especially likes behind-the-scenes content and user-generated content campaigns.
Likes the idea of using Instagram Stories to share the writing process.
